concept.title: Configuring QuayRegistry CR resources
concept.shortdesc: Configuring resources for managed components lets you adjust CPU and memory requests and limits for quay, clair, mirror, redis, and database pods. You can configure resources to run smaller test clusters or request more resources upfront to avoid performance issues.

conbody.p: The following components should not be set lower than their minimum requirements. Setting resources too low can cause issues with your deployment and, in some cases, result in failure of the pod’s deployment.

ul.li: clair: Recommended of 2 GB memory, 2 vCPUs

conbody.p: You can configure resource requests on the OpenShift Container Platform UI or directly by updating the QuayRegistry CR via the CLI.

note.p: The default values set for these components are the suggested values. Setting resource requests too high or too low might lead to inefficient resource utilization, or performance degradation, respectively.
